all.name: All Covered Competitions (19 Leagues & Cups)
all.format: Domestic 3-Pt Tables · UEFA/AFC League Phases · Domestic Knockout Cups · MLS Best-of-3
all.settlement: ⚠️ 90-Min + Stoppage Time Regulation Settlement across all 1X2, Totals, BTTS & Player Props (Extra Time & Penalty Kicks excluded unless market specifies 'To Advance').
all.cutlines: Tap any league tab above to filter by competition cutlines, or tap any Player, Club, or Match below for full interactive profiles.

eng.1.name: English Premier League
eng.1.format: 38 Matchweeks · #1 Tiebreaker: Goal Differential (GD), then Goals Scored
eng.1.cutlines: Top 4: UEFA Champions League · 5th: Europa League · 6th: Conference League · 18th–20th: Relegated to Championship

esp.1.name: LALIGA EA Sports
esp.1.format: 38 Matchweeks · #1 Tiebreaker: Head-to-Head Points/GD, then Overall GD
esp.1.cutlines: Top 4: UEFA Champions League · 5th: Europa League · 6th: Conference League · 18th–20th: Relegated

ita.1.name: Serie A Enilive
ita.1.format: 38 Matchweeks · Scudetto & 17th/18th ties settled via Playoff Match; other places H2H then GD
ita.1.cutlines: Top 4: UEFA Champions League · 5th: Europa League · 6th: Conference League · 18th–20th: Relegated

ger.1.name: German Bundesliga
ger.1.format: 34 Matchweeks · #1 Tiebreaker: Goal Differential (GD) · High-Pace Transition Environment
ger.1.cutlines: Top 4: UEFA Champions League · 5th: Europa League · 6th: Conference League · 16th: Relegation Playoff · 17th–18th: Relegated

fra.1.name: Ligue 1 McDonald's
fra.1.cutlines: Top 3: UEFA Champions League (4th: UCL Qual) · 5th: Europa League · 6th: Conference League · 16th: Playoff · 17th–18th: Relegated

eng.league_cup.name: EFL Carabao Cup 🏆
eng.league_cup.format: Single-Elimination Knockout · Tied @ 90' goes STRAIGHT to Penalties (No Extra Time before Semifinals!)
eng.league_cup.settlement: ⚠️ 90-Min + Stoppage Time Settlement! A 90-minute draw settles 1X2 as Draw even when a club advances on penalties.
eng.league_cup.cutlines: Winner Advances to Quarterfinals · High Midweek Squad Rotation Alert — verify confirmed Starting XI!

ger.dfb_pokal.name: DFB-Pokal 🏆
ger.dfb_pokal.format: Single-Elimination German Cup · Lower-Division Club Hosts Bundesliga Opponent
ger.dfb_pokal.settlement: ⚠️ 90-Min + Stoppage Time Settlement for 1X2, Spread, Totals & Player Props (30-min Extra Time & PKs only apply to 'To Advance').
ger.dfb_pokal.cutlines: Winner Advances to Round of 16 · Monitor rotation for clubs in UCL + Bundesliga action.

esp.copa_del_rey.name: Copa del Rey 🏆
esp.copa_del_rey.format: Single-Elimination Spanish Cup · Hosted at Lower-Seeded Club's Ground
esp.copa_del_rey.settlement: ⚠️ 90-Min + Stoppage Time Settlement for 1X2, Totals & Player Props (Extra Time & PKs excluded from 90-min markets).
esp.copa_del_rey.cutlines: Winner Advances · Heavy LaLiga squad rotation in early rounds creates asymmetric value.

uefa.champions.name: UEFA Champions League
uefa.champions.format: 8 League-Phase Matches (4 Home, 4 Away) · #1 Tiebreaker: Overall Goal Differential (GD) & Away Goals Scored
uefa.champions.cutlines: 1st–8th: Auto-Advance to Round of 16 · 9th–24th: Two-Leg Knockout Playoffs · 25th–36th: Eliminated (No Europa Drop-Down!)

uefa.europa.name: UEFA Europa League
uefa.europa.format: 8 League-Phase Matches · #1 Tiebreaker: Overall Goal Differential (GD)
uefa.europa.cutlines: 1st–8th: Auto-Advance to Round of 16 · 9th–24th: Two-Leg Knockout Playoffs · 25th–36th: Eliminated

afc.champions.name: AFC Champions League Elite

afc.champions.cutlines: Top 8 per Region: Advance to Round of 16 · 9th–12th: Eliminated

usa.1.name: MLS · Audi MLS Cup Playoffs
